header:
Track C's saved cursor := the block-store cursor: word 0x3460[C] := BStore_CursorBlock, byte 0x3482[C] := BStore_CursorOffset (TrackCursor_Save's twin, indexed by C instead of IY).
Its three directory callers pass C = (0x349F), the track the locate loop just sought with BStore_SeekChainToMeasure. Basis: callers + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:89897 `T_F40B54:	jp sub_F483B2  ; -> prom_b 0x483B2   x3` -- the directory slot all three named callers use
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:96983 `ld c, (13471:16)` -- Seq_LocateToCurrentMeasure: C = the track being located ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97000 `call T_F40B54` -- ... then the slot, after the seek succeeded

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:97053 `ld c, (13471:16)` -- SeqTrackCursors_LocateAllToCurrentMeasure: the same, its header already says "stores the cursor as that track's saved cursor (0x3460/0x3482 via sub_F483B2)"
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:98883 `ld c, (13471:16)` -- the in-module caller (0xF47F3A) also loads C = (0x349F)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99548 `ld a, c` -- body: IY = C
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99557 `mx_st_mr8 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IY, 1` -- ... -> byte (0x3482 + C)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:172309 `; TrackCursor_Save: the reverse: the BStore cursor into word[IY] at 0x3460 and byte[IY] at 0x3482.` -- the same two stores, indexed by IY

header:
Posts the CPU-2 message F0 50 87 <W> (A := W, then T_F41020 = Msg0716_PostSysEx50_87); CPU 2's arm 0x87 is VoiceDefaults_StoreFromPackedByte. The step-record module's callers pass 0x68 on block-store
failures (with status 15 / request 0x40AB, song memory full) and 0x62 / 0x76 on other paths; what the byte selects is not established. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:155139 `ld w, 104:opc` -- StepRecord_LoadMeasureBeat, on a BStore error (0xF6A24E) ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:155140 `calr sub_F67481` -- ... posts it, then returns W = 0xFF
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:157969 `ld w, 104:opc` -- StepRecord_BStoreAppendBytes when no block can be allocated ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:155369 `ld w, 98:opc` -- other step-record callers pass 0x62 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:148608 `ld a, w` -- body: A := W
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:90262 `T_F41020:	jp Msg0716_PostSysEx50_87  ; -> prom_a 0x418B2   x3` -- the slot it calls
prom_c/midi/midi_controllers.s:2192 `;          Its one reference is arm 0x87 of GlobalSetup_Dispatch, at 0xFB044F.` -- CPU 2 handles 0x87 in VoiceDefaults_StoreFromPackedByte
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:187773 `ld w, 104:opc` -- note: BStore_AppendBytes's own copy loads W = 0x68 and calls T_F41020 directly (0xF7A76C) without moving W into A

which with bit 3 clear calls Seq_ResetPositionToSongStart. The body of Playback_AcceptMidiStartAgain, and called by MidiFilePlay_OnSongSelect after loading the chosen song. Basis: callers + body + consumer.

header:
For a SysEx third-region request in the 0x060000 region at offset 82..151: fills the run descriptor at the pointer arg (0x0B83): +0 := 3, +7 := 0; offset 82 -> first DSP parameter 0x45, limit 1;
83..151 -> parameter offset - 83, limit 0x45; +3 := min(requested count, limit - first). SysExThirdRegion_FetchNextChunk then reads that run with DspParam_ReadByNumber. Basis: caller + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:75601 `calr sub_F37E1C` -- ... and replies with sub_F37E1C

header:
While (0x3550) bit 7 is set, decrements it once per sequencer pass; at 0x80 it clears (0x3550) and (0x34BB) bit 2, the flag that makes the MIDI-in path ignore 0xFA/0xFB.
sub_F44C51 arms it with 0x82 when it sets that bit itself, so that ignore lasts two passes. Called by Seq_MainLoopService. Basis: caller + body + the arming site.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:94320 `m_bit 7, MD16, 0x3550` -- body: armed by bit 7
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:68796 `m_bit 2, MD16, 0x34bb` -- bit 2 set -> the MIDI-in path returns before the 0xFA MIDI_RT_Start / 0xFB MIDI_RT_Continue arms

Arm 2 of Dispatch_3629, run by sub_F45E76 when the (0x3628) countdown reaches 0x80. With transport B stopped and (0x349F) := (0x36D6): unless sub_F49A3D (T_F40BE4) returns 0 -- a cycle-record take armed on
that track, which runs sub_F4A5B5 (T_F40C00) instead -- relocates to the cycle start, recaptures the end cursors and re-latches the track beats. The CYCLE RECORD start editor arms it after forcing END := START. Basis: table index + body + setter.

header:
Links every block 1..BStore_BlockCount into one free chain (header bit 7 clear, prev/next links, first byte 0x82), BStore_FreeHead := 1, BStore_FreeCount := BlockCount; the 17 chain-table entries
at 0x603500 := {0, 0xFFFF}; the track cursors 0x3460/0x3482 and the directory 0x60347E/0x6034A0 := {0xFFFF, 5}. First step of the block-store reset BStore_ResetWorkspaceToDefault reaches via T_F40C70. Basis: caller chain + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:107355 `calr sub_F4D7BD` -- ... whose tail calls it after resetting the chain table (the batch's BStore_WriteCursorByte attribution is label proximity)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108089 `m_and_mi8 MBI+r5, 0, 0x7f` -- per block: in-use bit cleared ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108104 `m_ld_mi16 MDD+r3, 0x01, 0xffff` -- chain table entries emptied

header:
Clears track (0x3736)'s bit in the record mask (0x3000)/(0x3002) and re-queues the REC/PLAY labels; outside panel mode 5 sets (0x0C05) := 0xE4 and empties the timed-event ring, in mode 5 runs
T_F409D0, CycleRecord_SetUpRecordTrack when cycle record is on, and the routing rebuild; ends with sub_F4E1B6. RealtimeRecordScreen_LcdKeyRow2 runs it for every track above the lowest armed one. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:109200 `ld (14134:16), c` -- RealtimeRecordScreen_LcdKeyRow2: after the lowest armed track, (0x3736) := each following track ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:109202 `calr sub_F4E151` -- ... and this (loop 0xF4E5C9-0xF4E5D9), so one record track remains
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:120899 `call T_RealtimeRecordScreen_LcdKeyRow2` -- LcdKeyRow2_RealtimeRecordScreen does that just before turning cycle record on (0xF563F9)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108393 `calr sub_F4E151` -- sub_F4E05B calls it when track (0x3736) is armed
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108494 `ld (12288:16), de` -- body: bit (0x3736) of (0x3000) cleared (rcf / stcf) ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108512 `call T_TimedEventRing_Discard` -- no: timed-event ring emptied
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108519 `call T_CycleRecord_SetUpRecordTrack` -- yes: cycle-record track set up again when cycle record is on
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:108521 `call T_NoteRouting_RebuildForSong` -- and the routing rebuilt

header:
`calr sub_F4EC2F / ret`: current measure := 1, (0x34D3) bit 1 := 1 -- the flag RealtimeRecord_Disarm tests and clears -- (0x34BB) bit 3 set and cleared again at measure 1, (0x34D4) bit 4 (position
request) set, Transport_StopAllRunning. ModeEnter_RealtimeRecord, the ENTER of panel mode 5, calls it through T_F40CE8. Basis: caller + body + the disarm twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:89974 `T_F40CE8:	jp sub_F4EC2B  ; -> prom_b 0x4EC2B   x1` -- its directory slot
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:120132 `call T_F40CE8` -- ModeEnter_RealtimeRecord, the ENTER of panel mode 5
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:109319 `calr sub_F4EC2F` -- body: sub_F4EC2F, then ret
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:109364 `m_bit 1, MD16, 0x34d3` -- RealtimeRecord_Disarm acts only while (0x34D3) bit 1 is set

header:
Toggles (0x34D9) bit 0, the count-in setting -- sub_F451E6 copies it into bit 1, which Transport_StartAllFromZero tests to start with a count-in -- except while a count-in runs ((0x34D9) bit 2 and
measure bit 15) or while transport A runs with neither bit set. The LcdKeyRow1 action of the CYCLE RECORD and REALTIME RECORD screens (RecordScreen_LcdKeyRow1). Basis: caller + body + the bit's readers.
basis: caller + body + readers of the bit
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:109675 `calr sub_F4EE73` -- RecordScreen_LcdKeyRow1 = `calr sub_F4EE73 / ret`, the LcdKeyRow1 action of both record screens
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:2450 `m_or_mi8 MB16, 0x34d9, 0x04` -- and bit 2 while it runs

header:
CYCLE RECORD screen values: CycleRecordScreen_StageValues, interpreter B from DL_F351A7 to Data_F351F9 on layer 0, the measure's count-in text (SeqScreen_DrawCountInMeasure), the (0x3755) and
(0x36CE) arrays on layer 1, show layers. Posted as a callback by ScreenEnter_CycleRecordScreen. RealtimeRecordScreen_DrawValues is its REALTIME RECORD twin. Basis: caller + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:121380 `ld xwa, sub_F55F45` -- ScreenEnter_CycleRecordScreen posts it to the callback queue
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:120052 `call T_DisplayListB_Run` -- interpreter B over DL_F351A7
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:119807 `; RealtimeRecordScreen_DrawValues: REALTIME RECORD screen values: RealtimeRecordScreen_StageValues, then on layer 2` -- the twin

header:
After the CYCLE RECORD start measure (0x3622) changed: if it now exceeds END (0x3624), END := START, the two fields re-blinked (sub_F569FA) and Dispatch_3629 action 2 scheduled ((0x3628) := 0x83,
(0x3629) := 2); otherwise action 0 is scheduled, or only the countdown re-armed when action 2 is already pending. Sets (0x34BB) bit 2 either way. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:121673 `ld (13858:16), wa` -- NumberPadKey_CycleRecordScreen stores a typed 1..999 in (0x3622) when field (0x36CE) = 1 ...

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99670 `;   CycleRecord's 0x3622 when UI_ScreenLatch is 6/8); locates every track there (T_SeqCycle_LocateTracksToCurrentMeasure with the playing mask forced` -- 0x3622 = CycleRecord's CYCLE START MEASURE (SeqCycle_LocateToStart's header)

header:
UI_DrawScratch+20 (0x2654) := the CYCLE PLAY end measure (0x3620), then posts sub_F56FC3, which hands Blink_Command the END field record DL_F34FF2+0x23 (command 6, SetState).
NumberPadKey_CyclePlayScreen calls it after every number entry on the END field ((0x3627) = 2). Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:122984 `ld (13856:16), wa` -- NumberPadKey_CyclePlayScreen stores a typed 1..999 in (0x3620) on field 2 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:122988 `calr sub_F56FA8` -- ... then always calls it
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:123042 `ld xiy, DL_F34FF2 + 0x23` -- sub_F56FC3: record DL_F34FF2+0x23 (first byte 0x06) ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:99788 `; SeqCycle_CaptureEndCursors: Saves the live track cursors, locates to CYCLE END MEASURE + 1 (CyclePlay's 0x3620, or` -- 0x3620 = CyclePlay's CYCLE END MEASURE

why_refused: Its only caller is SC1_DeadTail, the unreachable stale copy of an older SC1 build, and its own calr targets (0xF5A9B2, 0xF5AA9B, 0xF5AAA7) are not instruction boundaries of the live code.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:129965 `calr sub_F5B436` -- the only call, inside SC1_DeadTail
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:129902 `; SC1_DeadTail -- 259 bytes that nothing in this tree can reach` -- unreachable
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:130010 `calr 62833` -- calr to 0xF5A9B2, one of the stale targets the SC1_DeadTail header lists

For field A (12..15, layer 1..4's pan amount): when ModelingPage_Fields[A] is non-zero (zero = centre) runs record [A] of the pointer array Data_F32992+0x28 on layer 0
(RunDisplayListBFromPointerArray). SoundEditToneLayerPanning_PaintPanAmounts calls it for A = 12..15. Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:133479 `call sub_F5D4A7` -- ... calls it per field ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:17960 `sla wa, 2` -- RunDisplayListBFromPointerArray: XIY += A x 4, then runs that record

header:
Steps the read cursor (block at (0x126E), offset IY) one byte; past 0xFF it follows the +3 next link of block (0x0CBC), keeps the new number in (0x0CBC), BStore_ErrorCode := 2 if that block is
not allocated, else IY := 5. The body of BStore_ReadCursorAdvance_Call (whose header already describes it); sub_F5E83A's copy loops call it nine times. Basis: callers + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135914 `calr sub_F5EB9C` -- BStore_ReadCursorAdvance_Call is `calr sub_F5EB9C / ret`
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135601 `calr sub_F5EB9C` -- sub_F5E83A, one of its nine call sites
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135893 `ldw iy, 5` -- else offset 5, the first byte after the header
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142824 `; BStore_CursorAdvance -- ++cursor, following the chain at a block end` -- the single-cursor twin
